searched: Anthropic 2021–2026. Retrieved directly from anthropic.com: the Series B (2022) and Series C (2023) announcements, the Long-Term Benefit Trust page (2023, with its later undated footnote on membership changes), the Company page and the Leadership page (both undated, retrieved 2026-10-15), and announcements for Krieger (2024), Rao (2024), Kreps (2024), Fontaine (2025), Smith (2025), Patil (2025), Labs (2026), Liddell (2026), the Anthropic Institute (2026), Bernanke (2026) and Cuéllar (2026). The 2024 AWS re:Invent deck already in the dataset was retrieved again and its founder slide (PDF page 6) inspected as a rendered image to confirm the row layout. Jan Leike's and John Schulman's X posts were read through X's syndication endpoint; Schulman's post is a long note that the endpoint truncates before the passage naming Anthropic, and the relay route to x.com was refused (HTTP 403), so the Anthropic passage is taken from TechCrunch's quotation (reporting). Schulman's February 2025 departure has no located primary statement; TechCrunch's report is used. Web searches (anthropic.com news; Krieger, Rao, Liddell, Labs, Cuéllar, Smith, Fontaine, Institute, Mann, Leike, Schulman, Karnofsky, Kreps) were used only for discovery. https://www.anthropic.com/leadership returned a 404 page; the working path is /company/leadership. Not drafted: Holden Karnofsky (only reporting found; a member-of-technical-staff role that Anthropic did not announce, outside rule 11 scope); Ben Mann's role in Labs (the Labs post implies but does not state it); a departure of Jay Kreps from the board (the Company page retrieved 2026-10-15 does not list him, but no statement of a departure was found, so none is recorded). The Series A announcement (existing source) names only Dario and Daniela Amodei and gives no founding date; Anthropic's own pages located here give no complete founder roster.
